title: Remote Reconciliation & Payments Specialist (AI-Enhanced)
description:
## Description
﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker
This is a hands-on Remote Reconciliation & Payments Specialist (AI-Enhanced) role inside Chargeflow's Billing & Collections team. Money comes in from customers of every size — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts — across multiple payment channels, and you are the person who makes sure every payment is matched against what the customer was actually invoiced. It's detailed work, it lives largely in Excel, and getting it right matters.
The core of the job is ownership: you reconcile what a customer owes against what they've paid, you close the loop against the invoice we issued, and you don't let it go until it's genuinely resolved — including chasing an open item well after the month has closed. "It'll probably sort itself out" is not part of the role. If a customer hasn't paid their debt, you stay on it until they have.
You'll work across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or simply wrong — so a critical eye is not optional. You need to be the person who notices that two numbers don't agree and cares enough to find out why. It can be frustrating, but the payoff is real: there's genuine satisfaction in untangling a mess and getting it to tie out.
We're also a company that wants to do this smarter over time. You won't be expected to build automation from day one — but we do want someone who is hungry to turn manual, repetitive work into AI-assisted workflows, with Claude as your day-to-day partner for getting there. The role sits within Billing & Collections and reports to the Billing & Collections Manager.
About Chargeflow
Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.
Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.
What You’ll Own
Reconciliation & Collections
• Reconcile customer payments against invoices across the full customer base — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts.
• Match every incoming payment to what the customer was actually invoiced, and close the loop between the payment received and the invoice issued.
• Investigate every unmatched, partial, or unexpected item down to root cause — don't leave gaps open.
• Track what each customer owes, confirm the debt has actually been paid, and follow up until it's fully resolved — including items that carry past month-end.
• Own your accounts end to end: you're responsible for the reconciliation being clean, correct, and complete, not just started.
• Keep clear, well-documented working papers so anyone can see how a balance was reached.
Working Across the Systems
• Do the heavy lifting in Excel — this is a spreadsheet-intensive role (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets).
• Pull and cross-check data across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or inconsistent.
• Keep a critical eye at all times — assume the data needs verifying, and dig in when two numbers don't agree.
• Take real ownership of the details: notice the discrepancy, care about it, and drive it to a clean answer.
Communication & Responsiveness
• Be responsive to the people who depend on you across the company — Billing, Finance, Operations, and Customer Success.
• Work fluidly across the channels the business runs on: Slack, monday.com, and email.
• When it's the fastest way to resolve something, get on a call with a customer and walk them through their reconciliation directly.
• Explain a billing or reconciliation situation in plain, clear language to someone who isn't in finance.
Making the Work Smarter (Over Time)
• Look for manual, repetitive steps that shouldn't stay manual — and bring the hunger to improve them.
• Partner with Claude and other AI tools day-to-day to speed up reconciliation and reduce manual effort as you grow into the role.
## Requirements
What You Bring
• 2+ years of experience in reconciliation, collections, billing, or accounts receivable — ideally in fintech, SaaS, or eCommerce - Must
• A genuine ownership mindset — you take responsibility for your accounts, go down into the detail, and don't consider something done until it's actually resolved - Must
• The persistence to stay on an unpaid or unreconciled item until it's closed, including well after month-end — you're not comfortable letting things sit - Must
• Strong Excel skills — this is a spreadsheet-heavy role (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, large data sets) - Must
• A critical eye for data — comfortable working across multiple systems where the data is broken or inconsistent, and instinctively verifying rather than assuming - Must
• Strong attention to detail — able to spot when two numbers don't agree and to work a discrepancy down to zero - Must
• Responsive and easy to work with — comfortable fielding requests across Slack, monday.com, email, and the occasional customer call - Must
• Clear communicator — able to explain a reconciliation or billing issue simply to people who aren't in finance, including customers - Must
• Curious about doing the work smarter — interested in using AI tools (Claude included) to reduce manual effort over time. Prior automation experience is not required - Must
• Native or near-native English — clear, professional written and verbal communication - Must
• Comfortable working with customers of all sizes, from SMB to Enterprise - Must
• Familiarity with chargebacks, payment disputes, or PSP data — an advantage.
How We Work
We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and expect people to take ownership from problem to resolution. We build strong customer relationships through responsiveness, transparency, and measurable results.
This is a full-time, Remote position!
If you’re looking to take ownership of strategic enterprise relationships and directly influence customer retention and growth, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer - 4 Day Week + Remote
description:
Ever wondered how it would be to revolutionise one of the least digitised industries in the market, alongside a growing and switched-on team? Read on!
___________________________________________________________________________________
We are Shape.Construction!
We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION
It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).
We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.
We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech and watch this video about what we are doing)
The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and mission).
This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.
Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:
- Connects us with meaningful relationships
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures
4 core values for a good life
We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.
We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:
1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
Laminar Projects is proud to be recognized as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Construction, Engineering & Property™ for 2024! Join a team where learning, collaboration, and growth are at the core of everything we do, and where solving big challenges is part of the fun.
___________________________________________________________________________________
The Role
Purpose of the role
We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines deep knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong software engineering skills and a pragmatic approach to product development. This person will help us design, build and deploy AI-powered features across Shape App and Channels, working closely with the Product and SRE Teams to define optimal solutions and ensure they run reliably in production.
You should be excited by the challenge of turning AI potential into real, useful features, for construction teams, and you should know when a small, lean approach is better than a large, complex one.
Team
You will join a team of product-minded software engineers, designers, and strategists focused on improving the way construction projects are delivered. You will work closely with Product Managers to shape AI features, and with our SRE Team to ensure production-readiness. You will be the go-to expert on AI/LLMs and play a key role in shaping our AI capability.
Your top 3 objectives
1. Design Lean, Fit-for-Purpose AI Solutions: Choose and implement the most appropriate AI/LLM approach for each use case, balancing quality, performance and cost.
2. Integrate AI-features into our Applications: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
3. Prepare for Production: Work with SREs to ensure AI features are reliable, scalable, observable, and secure in production.
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Understand the Product Context: Work with product teams to translate user needs into clear AI opportunities and technical requirements.
2. Own the AI Feature Lifecycle: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning and evaluation.
3. Build AI-Backed Features: Contribute production-grade code that integrates AI capabilities into our apps, working alongside other engineers.
4. Guide Production Set-Up: Collaborate with SREs to define what infrastructure, observability, and scaling is required for each AI feature.
5. Stay Pragmatic and Up-to-Date: Continuously explore new development in LLMs and generative AI but always apply them with a product-first mindset.
Your Capabilities
You are a software engineer who understands how to use LLMs effectively, not just how to train them. You work well with ambiguity and know how to test your ideas quickly. You're comfortable collaborating with product teams and setting up production-grade systems.
As a candidate, you should have:
- Strong experience in applying LLMs and generative AI to real-world problems.
- Solid foundation in Phyton and ML frameworks (e.g. LangChain, Transformers, OpenAI APIs, etc.).
- Experience with multi-model evaluation and feedback loops.
- Production experience with embeddings, vector dabatases (like Pinecone, Weaviate or FAISS), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
- Familiarity with MLOps tooling and observability for inference pipelines.
- A bias for simplicity, clarity, and iterative delivery.
- The ability to communicate clearly with engineers, designers and non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining)
- Familiarity with production environments, APIs, and containerised systems (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Participation in AI communities, papers or OSS projects.
Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique expertise towards our collective success, so if you don't think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyways!
___________________________________________________________________________________
Salary and Benefits
Standard Stuff
- Competitive salary dependent on location and capability
- Paid Annual Leave (Number of days will depend on where you are based) + statutory Bank Holidays
- In-House Coaching Sessions
- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members.
The Life-Changing Stuff
- 4 Day Weeks: That’s right, 4 day weeks
- Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
- Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Shape exists
- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Shape. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Shape, development is unbounded
- Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us
________________________________________________________________________________________
Application
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
- Why do you want to join us?
- If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?
We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.
In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

title: Data Engineer - US Remote
description:
## What is PerfectServe?
PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.
PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
• In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
• PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.
If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!
## About the role
Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform.
We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly.
The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job.
## Why this role, specifically
Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled.
You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported.
## What you will do
• Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems
• Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust
• Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape
• Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks
• Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews
• Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own
## What you bring
• Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some
• Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent
• Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework
• A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar
• Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent)
• Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.
We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.
Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.
About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.
Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.
We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.
Your Responsibilities
Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.
Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.
Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.
Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.
Core Qualifications
You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.
You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.
You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.
You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.
You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.
You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.
You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.
You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.
Preferred Qualifications
Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).
Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.
Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.
Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.
Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

title: AI Engineer - Large Scale Pre-Training
description:
## About us
We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.
Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
## Your mission
The role
As an AI Engineer for Large-Scale Pre-Training, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the infrastructure we use to train large-scale robot foundation models on petabyte-scale datasets across our GPU fleet. This infrastructure is a critical part of our research and development cycle: it must strike the right balance between stability and velocity, enabling fast research iterations based on reliable results. This is a full-time, permanent position.
## Your profile
Key responsibilities
Scalable Training Infrastructure: Develop software infrastructure to train multi-billion-parameter robot foundation models efficiently on large video datasets across multi-node GPU clusters.
Data Pipelines: Build high-throughput, reliable data pipelines that stream, decode and preprocess petabyte-scale video datasets, keeping our GPUs fully utilized and supporting deterministic, resumable training.
Experiment Management: Build the tools to organize, monitor and optimize large training workloads and model sweeps. Remove bottlenecks in our training pipelines and make sure all our runs maintain the highest possible goodput.
Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience training multi-billion-parameter models on multi-node GPU clusters, including supervising long-running experiments, in-flight debugging and optimizing goodput and MFU.
Core Skills: Deep expertise in distributed training and training efficiency at scale. In detail:
Distributed Training: Data parallelism and sharding (DDP, FSDP/FSDP2, ZeRO), tensor, pipeline and sequence parallelism, and frameworks such as Megatron-Core, DeepSpeed, TorchTitan or JAX/GSPMD.
Training Efficiency: BF16/FP8 mixed precision, activation checkpointing, FlashAttention, and profiling with PyTorch Profiler or Nsight Systems.
Fault Tolerance: Distributed and asynchronous checkpointing, automatic recovery, and diagnosing NCCL and hardware failures.
Core Stack: Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, CUDA, NCCL, and cluster orchestration with Slurm or Kubernetes.
A plus: High-throughput data pipelines for large video datasets (WebDataset, Mosaic Streaming, Ray Data, DALI/NVDEC); custom kernels in Triton or CUDA; familiarity with multimodal or robot foundation models (VLAs, video transformers, diffusion/flow-matching policies); experiment tracking and sweep infrastructure (Weights & Biases, MLflow, Hydra).
Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and an engineer with a research mindset who understands the workflows of cutting-edge AI research and supports them with rigorous software engineering.
## Why us?
The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.
Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.
Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.
Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Stockbroking
description:
## About Doit
We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
## The Role
We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.
This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
## What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
## What We're Looking For
Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
## The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
## This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.
People who launch features and then stop caring.
PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.
## Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.
## Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
## Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Position

We’re looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You’ll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models. 

We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street’s research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning. 

Beyond our own environment, we also recognize the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We’re also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we’re interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined.

If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of our newest hires.

About You

We don’t expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we’re looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • A top-notch programmer with a love for technology
  • Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes
  • Fluent in English

If you'd like to get an idea of what we cover in our software engineering interview process, you can visit our interview prep page.

description:

## The Role
You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.
This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.
## What You'll Work On
Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.
Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.
Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.
Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.
Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.
Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.
## Who We're Looking For
A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.
## Your Background
4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.
Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.
Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).
Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.
Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.
Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.
## Nice to Have
Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.
Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).
Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.
Robotics or field data collection.
Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.

Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

description:

About Capco

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.

We're looking for a senior software engineer with strong ML and GenAI skills to deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions for our financial services clients. You'll own the full lifecycle — from data pipelines and model development through production deployment and monitoring — working autonomously in complex, regulated environments.

This is your chance to make a real difference! 

YOUR CAPCO DAY 

  • Design and build end-to-end data pipelines and feature engineering workflows on large-scale transactional data in regulated client environments
  • Train, calibrate, and validate ML models — supervised, unsupervised, and ensemble — including threshold analysis and production-grade explainability
  • Develop GenAI-powered solutions such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and LLM-based automation to accelerate knowledge-intensive client processes
  • Deploy and monitor models in production with drift detection, performance tracking, and multi-environment release management (Dev → Staging → Prod)
  • Work directly with client stakeholders — from compliance SMEs to engineering teams — delivering documentation, knowledge transfer, and long-term enablement

 

YOUR CAPCO FIT

  • Strong software engineering foundation: Python, Spark, CI/CD, containerized deployments (Kubernetes), and production-grade pipeline orchestration (Airflow or equivalent)
  • Data Science depth: feature engineering at scale, statistical modeling, experiment design, model explainability (e.g. Shapley Values), and threshold calibration under business constraints
  • Hands-on ML experience: tree-based methods, neural networks, ensemble design, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and out-of-time testing
  • Practical GenAI experience: LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows for automating knowledge-intensive processes
  • Fluent German and strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to produce audit-ready documentation for regulated environments

 

Ready to take the Next Step 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.  This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
## What We're Looking For
Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.

Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

description:
Role Summary
The Cloud Engineer (Microsoft Azure) is responsible for designing, implementing, operating, securing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and platform services hosted on MicrosoftAzure. The role ensures that cloud environments are resilient, secure, scalable, and compliant with Government ICT policies, security standards, and operational requirements.
The Cloud Engineer will work closely with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and project teams to support cloud migration, modernization, automation, and day-to-day operations.

Cloud Infrastructure Management

• Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of cloud-hosted systems.
